item.headinajar.life_support_jar.how: Load it into a Separation Chair
gui.headinajar.let_go.tooltip: Give up on this jar. You die and wake up with a fresh body.
gui.headinajar.let_go.title: Let go?
gui.headinajar.let_go.body: Your head gives up. You die, your modules drop, and you respawn with a body.
module.headinajar.hop_springs.desc: Hops the jar along when you walk, at 60% speed.
module.headinajar.manipulator_arm.desc: A little arm: mine, place, use items, fight and pick things up.
module.headinajar.telekinesis.desc: R grabs the block, creature or item you look at; R drops it, attack throws it.
module.headinajar.drill_bit.desc: Mines three times as fast. Needs an arm or a body.
module.headinajar.heat_shield.desc: Fire and lava can't hurt the jar.
module.headinajar.water_jet.desc: Swim fast; hop along the bottom.
item.headinajar.relay_goggles.how: Worn by your head. The Separation Chair fits them.
item.headinajar.collar_cam.how: Bolted to your neck: your body sees through it.
item.headinajar.head_satchel.how: With this in your inventory, use your head to carry it. Sneak-use to set it down.
item.headinajar.suture_kit.how: Carrying your head: hold use. As a jar: use it on your body.
message.headinajar.link_lost.dimension: Your body left the dimension: link lost
message.headinajar.signal_too_weak: Signal too weak to reach your body
message.headinajar.body_died: Your body has died. You wake up in your head.
message.headinajar.portal_blocked: Your head is in another dimension. Please bring it.
message.headinajar.need_satchel: You need a Head Satchel to carry your head
message.headinajar.suture_how: Carry your own head first (Head Satchel), or use the kit on your body as a jar
dolores.headinajar.start: DOLORES: Thank you for choosing Elective Separation. Please keep your arms inside the chair.
dolores.headinajar.gas: DOLORES: Administering a pleasant gas. Breathe normally. Or don't.
dolores.headinajar.scan: DOLORES: Scanning. Please hold still. You have a lovely neck.
dolores.headinajar.cut: DOLORES: Commencing separation. This will not hurt for very long.
dolores.headinajar.jar: DOLORES: Your head is now in a jar. Congratulations on your promotion.
dolores.headinajar.done: DOLORES: Neuro-link established. Please collect your head on the way out.
dolores.headinajar.abort: DOLORES: Procedure cancelled. Your head remains attached. For now.
dolores.headinajar.new_blade: DOLORES: New blade fitted. So shiny.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.power: DOLORES: Insufficient power. I refuse to stop halfway.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.jar: DOLORES: Where would we put your head? Insert a Life Support Jar.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.goggles: DOLORES: Relay Goggles required. You will want to see.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.collar: DOLORES: Collar Cam required. Your neck needs a hat.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.saline: DOLORES: Four bottles of Cranial Saline, please. Heads get thirsty.
dolores.headinajar.refuse.already: DOLORES: Our records show your head is already off.
gui.headinajar.chair.sit: Sit in the chair to sign
gui.headinajar.chair.form.body: I, %s, consent to the removal of my head, and accept that it is now company property.
gui.headinajar.chair.form.hold: Hold the button for two seconds. You can still get up before the cut.
hud.headinajar.head: HEAD
command.headinajar.separated: %s is now a head in a jar
command.headinajar.trusted: %s may now handle your head and body
command.headinajar.status: %s: form %s, link %s%%, head %s, body %s, charge %s FE
item.headinajar.surgical_wrench.how: Use a Tesla Node, then the one it should power. Sneak-use to unlink.
message.headinajar.dehydrating: Your head is dehydrating! Find saline.
message.headinajar.tesla_from: Sending node chosen: now use the receiving node
message.headinajar.tesla_too_far: Too far: Tesla Nodes reach 16 blocks
message.headinajar.printer_has_head: Only a head in its jar can order a new body
message.headinajar.printer_missing: The printer needs all its materials and 2000 mB of saline
message.headinajar.printed: Your new body is ready. It is a little damp.
gui.headinajar.printer.need: 16 flesh, 8 bone blocks, 4 redstone blocks, 8 slime
book.headinajar.handbook.landing: Everything a new employee needs to know about keeping their head. Please read before signing anything.
placard.headinajar.0: HEADS MUST BE SECURED AT ALL TIMES
placard.headinajar.2: THIS FACILITY HAS GONE 0 DAYS WITHOUT AN INCIDENT
placard.headinajar.3: LOST HEADS WILL BE HELD AT RECEPTION FOR 30 DAYS
placard.headinajar.4: KEEP HANDS, FEET AND NECK CLEAR OF THE BLADE
placard.headinajar.6: REPORT ALL HEADLESS WANDERING TO YOUR SUPERVISOR
placard.headinajar.7: A CLEAN JAR IS A HAPPY JAR
placard.headinajar.8: NO TELEKINESIS IN THE BREAK ROOM
placard.headinajar.10: IN CASE OF FIRE, TAKE YOUR HEAD
module.headinajar.suction_cups.desc: Walk into a wall to climb it; sneak to hang on.
module.headinajar.spider_legs.desc: The jar walks at 80% speed and steps up blocks.
module.headinajar.speaker_grille.desc: What you say in chat floats above your jar.
module.headinajar.saline_recycler.desc: Halves the saline your head uses.
module.headinajar.shock_lid.desc: Zaps anything that hits the jar in melee.
module.headinajar.self_righting_gyro.des: No knockback, and no upside-down views.
module.headinajar.life_sign_monitor.desc: Shows your body's health while you're in the jar.
module.headinajar.hat_mount.desc: Your helmet sits on the lid.
item.headinajar.surgical_saw.how: Use on a mob below 25% health to make it a host body a jar can pilot.
item.headinajar.surgical_saw.how2: With an empty Life Support Jar in your off hand, keep the head instead.
item.headinajar.lunk_chassis.desc: Strong, slow, hits like a truck.
item.headinajar.rover_chassis.desc: Fast, with 9 slots of cargo. Sneak-use it to open the hold.
item.headinajar.spider_walker_chassis.de: Climbs walls and never takes fall damage.
item.headinajar.shell.how: Place it, then use it as a jar to climb in. Runs on your charge.
message.headinajar.saw_refused: The saw refuses: bosses, named mobs, other people's pets and hosts are off limits.
message.headinajar.saw_too_healthy: Too lively. Wear it down below a quarter of its health first.
message.headinajar.host_busy: Someone is already in that body
message.headinajar.embalmed: Embalmed: fresh again, and it keeps longer
message.headinajar.laced: Neural Lace grafted: this body will never decay
message.headinajar.lace_needs_sync: The lace needs at least 50% sync to take
message.headinajar.no_cargo: Only the Rover has a cargo hold
message.headinajar.jarred_head: A jarred %s head. It looks at you.
hud.headinajar.handshake: NEURAL HANDSHAKE %s/3: press %s on the ring
mecha_module.headinajar.hydraulic_legs.d: Lets the mecha walk. Stride trades speed for power.
mecha_module.headinajar.anchor_clamps.de: Sneak to brace: no knockback, no moving.
mecha_module.headinajar.jump_jets.desc: Three mid-air bursts (jump again in the air).
mecha_module.headinajar.rocket_pack.desc: Flight, if its thrust beats the mecha's mass.
mecha_module.headinajar.glider_wings.des: Hold jump while falling to glide.
mecha_module.headinajar.cargo_hold.desc: 27 slots; drills and the Combustion Kernel use it.
mecha_module.headinajar.passenger_pod.de: A seat for a friend in any form.
mecha_module.headinajar.combustion_kerne: 80 FE/t from fuel in the Cargo Hold.
mecha_module.headinajar.armor_plating.de: 10 to 30% less damage. Thickness trades protection for mass.
mecha_module.headinajar.fire_suppression: Fire immunity for mecha and pilot.
mecha_module.headinajar.life_support_rec: Keeps the pilot's saline and charge full.
mecha_module.headinajar.signal_booster.d: A moving relay for your link.
mecha_module.headinajar.drill.desc: Hold to mine. Torque over half: a 3x3 head.
mecha_module.headinajar.chainsaw.desc: Hold on a log to fell the whole tree; 8 damage.
mecha_module.headinajar.grapple_hook.des: Pulls you to a block, or a creature to you.
mecha_module.headinajar.rivet_gun.desc: Five shots a second; uses iron nuggets.
mecha_module.headinajar.riot_shield.desc: Hold: 80% less damage from the front.
mecha_module.headinajar.bio_scanner.desc: Shows what you look at in more detail.
gui.headinajar.gantry.need_frame: Put a frame in the top-left slot
message.headinajar.not_your_mecha: That mecha belongs to someone else
